label: stand 1
title: Stand still
instruction: Stand still, facing the camera, your arms down.

label: walk 1
title: Walk
instruction: Squat as you would to make your horse WALK: calmly, at your own pace.

label: trot 1
title: Trot
instruction: Squat as you would to make your horse TROT: brisker, at your own pace.

label: gallop 1
title: Gallop
instruction: Squat as you would to make your horse GALLOP: as fast as you comfortably can.

label: stop 1
title: Stop
instruction: Stop squatting and stand still, as if your horse should halt.
